purpose: Test whether proportional prioritized replay stabilizes rare successful Minecart trajectories under the otherwise unchanged remediation-v1 PCQN backbone.

pre_execution_amendments.execution_state: No remediation-v2 qualification seed or validation evaluation had executed.
pre_execution_amendments.issue: The original loss_weighting text specified squared TD although remediation v1 and the executable architecture use masked Huber loss, which would have introduced an unintended second factor.
pre_execution_amendments.resolution: Retain the remediation-v1 masked Huber loss and apply each sampled transition's normalized importance weight before the existing active-head batch reduction.
pre_execution_amendments.scientific_effect: Restores the declared single-factor comparison: only the replay strategy changes from uniform to proportional prioritized replay.

intervention.name: proportional_prioritized_experience_replay
intervention.importance_weight: w_i = (N * P(i))^(-beta), normalized by the maximum weight in the sampled batch
intervention.priority_update: After each optimizer step, set priority_i to epsilon plus the mean absolute pre-update Double-DQN TD error over reward objectives and bootstrap heads active for transition i.
intervention.loss_weighting: Multiply each transition's masked vector Huber loss by its normalized importance weight before the existing active-head batch reduction.
no_additional_changes: no network, optimizer, exploration, target-update, or budget change
intervention.selection_rationale: The predeclared v1 behavior probe observed successful mining and delivery at positive checkpoints followed by zero Mine actions and zero delivery at later checkpoints within the same seed. This satisfies the locked rare-transition-retention rule for prioritized replay.

unchanged_from_remediation_v1: network architecture, bootstrap masks, optimizer, and learning rate
masked Huber loss family and active-head reduction
training interactions, gradient-update count, replay capacity, and batch size
target-update, exploration, curriculum-evaluation, checkpoint, and validation schedules
fixed training preference pool and immutable validation preferences

evaluation.checkpoint_selection: maximum protocol-scaled hypervolume; break exact ties by expected utility, then earlier checkpoint

selected_checkpoint_requirements: At least 8 of 160 validation episodes have a positive return in ore objective 0.
At least 8 of 160 validation episodes have a positive return in ore objective 1.
Each ore objective has at least two distinct positive episode-return values.
All return tensors and budget counters are finite and provenance-valid.
No final-test or shifted-environment data were accessed.
pass_rule.threshold_rationale: The fixed 5% event-rate floor rejects a lucky isolated ore delivery while remaining a qualification threshold rather than a performance-effect target.

qualification.failure_rule: If any seed fails, stop algorithmic remediation for the current course scope. Do not create remediation v3 or access final test without an explicit supervisor decision between a versioned Minecart scope amendment and reporting the blocked negative result.

course_revision_after_pass.minecart_pcqn_update_schedule: identical prioritized-replay backbone across all 13 PCQN arms
course_revision_after_pass.minecart_comparator_rule: Comparator budgets and update accounting require a separate fairness qualification in the revised study before execution.
course_revision_after_pass.lunarlander_rule: Unchanged LunarLander artifacts may be carried forward only by exact hash in the revised manifest; they do not unlock a partial final test.
course_revision_after_pass.checkpoint_lock_rule: No checkpoint lock or final-test access until the revised matrix and all required qualifications complete.
